mapper.select: SELECT p.name AS player_name, COUNT(*) AS wins FROM game_players gp JOIN players p ON p.id = gp.player_id WHERE gp.is_winner = TRUE GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY wins DESC
SELECT p.name AS player_name, SUM(gp.score) AS total_score FROM game_players gp JOIN players p ON p.id = gp.player_id GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY total_score DESC
